reading.passage: When the Sky Railway was planned, the builders left thirty-three passages under the line so that the Tibetan antelopes could keep moving freely. At first the shy animals stayed away, but the workers waited patiently. Now the antelopes have been using these crossings safely for years.
reading.passageCn: 天路修建时,建设者在铁路下留了三十三条通道,好让藏羚羊继续自由活动。起初害羞的动物不敢靠近,但工人耐心等待。如今藏羚羊已安全使用这些通道多年。
